 Ryan Seacrest Comforts ‘Wheel of Fortune’ Contestant Who Missed Out on $50K Prize
 Published
 5 days ago on
 November 4, 2026 
 By
 Vanessa Bermudez 
 Add Closer on Google 
 Wheel of Fortune/ABC 
 Ryan Seacrest sure knows how to connect with Wheel of Fortune contestants.
 During the Tuesday, November 3, episode of the hit game show, Seacrest, 51, offered player Shawn Broderick , who missed out on a $50,000 prize in the final bonus round, a hug.
 “We had a great night,” Seacrest comforted Broderick, 31, as cited by E! News .
 Wheel of Fortune/ABC 
 Although Broderick failed to take home the grand prize, he still walked away with $23,650 in winnings, including a $7,200 trip to Vietnam.
 “Well, you said you were single. Gotta find somebody for that great trip, right?” Seacrest joked.
 “Anybody, please apply,” quipped Broderick.
 Don’t expect him to make it a boys’ trip. Despite Seacrest’s amiable behavior, Broderick seemed more interested in befriending Vanna White .
 “No disrespect,” Broderick quipped. “I’m incredibly excited to meet you, but it’s gotta be Vanna. I’m nervous to even say hello, but Vanna, you are the best.”
 Wheel of Fortune/ABC 
 In December 2025, White, 69, opened up about her experience of working with Seacrest after Wheel of Fortune longtime host Pat Sajak stepped down in 2024 .
 “We get along great,” White told E! News at the time. “I think our chemistry is good. He’s such a nice guy and he’s so professional and hardworking and we just gel.”
 Seacrest started hosting Wheel of Fortune in September 2024, for the show’s 42nd season.
